# Private AI that runs on your device. Your chats never leave it.

The model is downloaded once and answers on your device, so what you ask, write and attach stays with you. No account, no ads, and no signal needed.

Open CuriousLMRead the offline guide

Internet is needed for the first visit, model downloads and updates.

The short answer

## What does local AI mean?

Local AI performs inference on the device you are using. The model and the software that runs it are downloaded first; after that, a prompt can be processed without sending it to a hosted model API. This differs from a private cloud chatbot, which may protect data in transit or limit retention but still computes the answer on remote servers.

Built for everyday work

## More than a local model playground. [...] ## Your words never leave your device.

Chats, projects, attached files and downloaded models are stored on your device, in the browser's private site storage or the Android app's private storage. Your chats, files, memories and settings are encrypted there. There is no CuriousLM account and no copy on a server. [...] ### Which files can local AI work with?

PDF, Word (DOCX), plain text, Markdown, CSV, HTML, JSON and source code files, plus photos: models that can see look at them, and in the Android app the writing in a photo of a letter or bill is read on the phone, so any model can explain it. Scanned PDFs without a text layer are not read yet.

### Will every phone run every local model?

No. Speed depends on memory, graphics support and the model itself. CuriousLM shows each model's size and how well it suits your device before you download it, and recommends one that runs well.

No account required

## Try private local AI in your browser.

Open CuriousLM, choose a model that suits your device, and every chat stays with you.

results.content:
Think out loud. Nobody else is listening.  
  
Private AI on your phone. Ask what you'd never type into a search bar, and know what needs you before you ask. The AI runs on your phone, so what you ask and every answer stay there. Free, no account, no ads.  
  
A PRIVATE PLACE TO THINK  
  
Talk through a decision, a hard message or a plan: whether to take the new job, how to ask for a raise, what to say to a friend. Typed or out loud, the conversation stays with you.  
  
A MODEL MADE FOR YOUR PHONE  
  
Our own model, Curious 2B, answers, writes, explains and reads photos like any good assistant, and is trained for your phone too: your messages, your calendar, your reminders. Prefer another? Choose from open models by size and speed, and switch whenever you like. [...] TAP A WORD. SEE THE ODDS.  
  
Words the model was unsure about stay faintly underlined. Tap one to see the other words that nearly came next, with the odds, and pick one to take the answer a different way.  
  
WHAT NEEDS YOU, BEFORE YOU ASK  
  
With your permission, source by source, CuriousLM reads your notifications and calendar on your phone and tells you who is waiting on a reply, what is due and what is coming up. Replies come drafted, ready to send with a tap. Nothing read on your phone leaves it.  
  
ASK ABOUT YOUR SCREEN [...] Private AI on your phone. Think out loud and know what needs you before you ask.
